userImpact: Screen-reader users cannot identify icon-only top-bar controls (display/grid/fullscreen/chat/notifications) — they are announced as unlabeled buttons.
businessImpact: WCAG 2.1 4.1.2 failure; accessibility-compliance risk for a payroll product used by HR/finance staff.
expected: All interactive controls have an accessible name (aria-label/text).
actual: axe 'button-name' (critical, 1 node) + 'link-name' (serious, 3 nodes): top-bar icon buttons and logo/icon links have empty accessible names.
rootCause: Icon-only buttons/links rendered without aria-label or visually-hidden text.
suggestedFix: Add aria-label to each icon control (e.g. 'Notifications', 'Messages', 'Full screen').

userImpact: Low-vision users may not be able to read text that fails minimum contrast.
actual: axe 'color-contrast' (serious, 4 nodes).
rootCause: Light-grey secondary text / muted labels below contrast threshold.
suggestedFix: Darken muted text tokens to meet 4.5:1.

userImpact: Assistive-tech landmark navigation is impaired (no single main landmark; content outside regions).
expected: Page exposes one <main> landmark; content within landmarks.
actual: axe 'landmark-one-main' (moderate, 1) + 'region' (moderate, 1).
rootCause: SPA shell lacks a <main> wrapper / ARIA regions.

userImpact: A resource fails to load on every authenticated page (console 404).
businessImpact: Broken asset/endpoint on core pages; may hide a missing icon/feature or a mis-wired request.
expected: No failed network requests / console errors on load.
actual: Console: 'Failed to load resource: the server responded with a status of 404 ()' on load.
rootCause: A static asset or API call returns 404 (needs HAR to identify the exact URL).
suggestedFix: Capture HAR, identify the 404 request, fix the broken reference/route.

userImpact: The 10 Settings setup cards remain in skeleton-loading state for a noticeable time after navigation (>15s in one observed run) before content/statuses populate.
businessImpact: Slow perceived performance on the primary setup hub.
expected: Cards populate promptly (<2-3s) with status badges.
actual: Cards rendered as grey skeleton placeholders well after the header; content load is slow / late.
rootCause: Per-card status data fetched lazily / serially after route render.
suggestedFix: Parallelise/cache the setup-status queries; show partial content sooner.

userImpact: An Administrator cannot create or invite users — user management is gated by an inactive subscription.
businessImpact: The entire user/role lifecycle (create→assign role→login→verify→deactivate) is blocked; no multi-role testing is possible until the subscription is renewed in Company Admin.
expected: User is created / invited and can log in.
actual: User creation blocked: server returns 422 "Your subscription is not active. Renew your subscription in Company Admin before adding users." . Additionally all user-mutation routes (edit/activate/deactivate/reset-password/assign-role) are read-only (HTTP 405 on write), and role→permission assignment is a silent no-op.
rootCause: Tenant subscription inactive (server gate) + user write-endpoints not exposed.
suggestedFix: Renew/activate the sandbox subscription in Company Admin to enable user management testing; expose user write/role-assignment endpoints.

userImpact: Admin cannot set a working password when creating a user — the created account cannot be logged into.
businessImpact: Blocks admin-provisioned access; every new user must self-activate via email, and admin/QA cannot log in as users to verify role enforcement.
expected: Login succeeds with the admin-set password.
actual: Login → 422 'Invalid password' (admin-set password silently ignored; same result as a wrong password).
rootCause: Create endpoint ignores user_data.password (sends an activation/invite path instead).
suggestedFix: Either honour the admin-set password, or document the email-activation flow and expose an admin 'set/reset password'.

userImpact: role_ids passed at user-create time are silently ignored.
businessImpact: Misleading API — create accepts role_ids but does not assign; roles must be set via POST /roles/{id}/assign-users.
actual: roles=[] after create; assignment only works via POST /roles/{id}/assign-users.
suggestedFix: Honour role_ids at create, or reject it as unsupported.

userImpact: New users face a forced first-login password change AND the auth is a multi-domain SSO (payroll.kedebah.com ↔ sbxkedebah-v2.npontu.com/clients/sign-in).
businessImpact: Per-role login automation (and any SSO client) must handle: redesigned login (Email/Username + Password), a forced Change-Password gate, and a cross-domain IdP sign-in. Single-domain login assumptions break.
steps: Login with a provided temp password
Observe 'Change Password — set a new password before continuing'
expected: Single-domain login OR a documented SSO flow.
actual: Multi-domain SSO + forced password change; automation lands on the npontu IdP sign-in and cannot complete the handshake.
rootCause: Central Kedebah identity provider (npontu) separate from the payroll app.
suggestedFix: Document the SSO/login contract; provide pre-activated accounts (password already changed) or an admin impersonation/token endpoint for QA.

userImpact: QA automation SUBMITTED forced-password-change forms on the 4 real accounts — the provided temp passwords may now be CHANGED (to QaPhase4_<role>_9X!) or left inconsistent.
businessImpact: Account owner must reset/recover these accounts; temp passwords likely consumed.
steps: Automated login triggered the forced Change-Password and submitted current=temp,new=QaPhase4_<role>_9X!
actual: Passwords for Admin (and possibly Manager/Reports/Employee) may now be QaPhase4_admin_9X! / _manager_ / _reports_ / _employee_ — or in an unknown state if the change partially failed.
suggestedFix: Owner should reset these 4 account passwords via the identity provider.

userImpact: Newly-created role users authenticate, change password, and select the business, but the Enterprise Module Launcher shows 'No modules found' — they cannot enter the Payroll module at all.
businessImpact: Provisioning a user in Payroll does NOT grant the Payroll MODULE at the enterprise level — new users are stranded at the launcher and cannot use payroll. Blocks all per-role Payroll enforcement testing AND real usage.
steps: Enterprise login as a new role user
expected: The Payroll module tile is present and launchable for a provisioned Payroll user.
actual: Enterprise Modules section empty ('No modules found for ""').
rootCause: Enterprise module access is provisioned separately from the Payroll role; the new users were created in Payroll but not granted the Payroll module at the enterprise/identity level.
suggestedFix: Grant the Payroll module to the role accounts in the enterprise portal (or auto-provision the module when a payroll user is created).

userImpact: After logout, navigating directly to a protected route (/clients/select-module) did NOT redirect to sign-in within the test window — the authenticated route was reachable post-logout.
businessImpact: Possible session-guard gap (broken post-logout protection). MUST be confirmed: could also be an SPA client-side redirect delay rather than a server-side guard failure.
steps: Observe URL stayed on the protected route ~3s later
actual: Protected route reachable ~3s post-logout (TC-AUTH-009)
rootCause: Unconfirmed — post-logout route guard vs SPA redirect-delay
suggestedFix: Confirm server-side route protection clears the session immediately; re-test with longer settle + assert the login form renders.

userImpact: A payroll period has a pay-date on Sunday 2026-05-31 that was NOT shifted off the weekend, while Saturday pay-dates ARE shifted (TC-CYCLE-013 PASS) — inconsistent weekend-rule application.
businessImpact: Employees could be scheduled to be paid on a non-banking day; inconsistent holiday-rule handling.
expected: Weekend pay-date shifted to the preceding Friday (per CYCLE-010)
actual: pay_date 2026-05-31 falls on a Sunday (TC-CYCLE-012 FAIL)
rootCause: Unconfirmed — confirm the schedule's holiday_rule config for this period (rule out 'by design')
suggestedFix: Apply the weekend/holiday shift consistently to Sunday as well as Saturday.
